law_record.title: Designation of through highways and intersections requiring stop or yield (3)
law_record.text: The driver of a vehicle approaching a yield sign if required for safety to stop shall stop before entering the crosswalk on the nearest side of the intersection or, if there is no crosswalk, at a clearly marked stop line, or if none, then at the point nearest the intersecting highway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting highway.

activation_conditions: the subject is the driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection whose approach carries a yield sign
a stop is required for safety — the judgement element: a conflict with traffic on the intersecting highway that cannot be avoided without halting
residue: 'if required for safety' is a judgement standard: no scene contains it, so a bound on drv.time_to_conflict must be declared as an operationalization claim
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: where a stop is required for safety, it occurs before the crosswalk, else the stop line, else the point of view
the need to stop is judged on the approach, not after entry; the obligation lapses once the conflict has passed
